title: Extend parameter layout with intelligence contraction and bloom groups
description:
Modify Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp ONLY. Replace the empty placeholder definition of shredspace::addIntelligenceParameters with the complete INTEL detector, contraction, and bloom groups. This is a serialized same-file write: do not alter the GLOBAL/PERF/TIME/STEREO/SCENE helpers from b.2 or the voice helper from b.3, and do not touch the header.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h (INTEL_* constants)
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h (addIntelligenceParameters declaration)
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp (construction style used by b.2 and b.3)

EXACT PARAMETERS (all juce::AudioParameterFloat unless stated; transcribe literally):

Detector:
- INTEL_SENSITIVITY: 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 55.0
- INTEL_INPUT_GATE: -80.0 to -20.0 dB, default -55.0, suffix " dB"
- INTEL_DENSITY_WINDOW: 200.0 to 1000.0 ms, default 500.0, suffix " ms"
- INTEL_DENSITY_START: 1.0 to 8.0 events/second, default 3.0, suffix " ev/s"
- INTEL_DENSITY_FULL: 6.0 to 20.0 events/second, default 12.0, suffix " ev/s"
- INTEL_SUSTAIN_START: 50.0 to 800.0 ms, default 180.0, suffix " ms"
- INTEL_SUSTAIN_FULL: 150.0 to 2000.0 ms, default 650.0, suffix " ms"
- INTEL_PHRASE_GAP: 20.0 to 500.0 ms, default 120.0, suffix " ms"

Contraction:
- INTEL_CONTRACTION_ATTACK: 1.0 to 100.0 ms, default 8.0, skewForCentre around 15.0, suffix " ms"
- INTEL_CONTRACTION_RELEASE: 20.0 to 1000.0 ms, default 220.0, skewForCentre around 250.0, suffix " ms"
- INTEL_WET_REDUCTION: 0.0 to 18.0 dB, default 8.0, suffix " dB"
- INTEL_TAIL_REDUCTION: 0.0 to 2.0 octaves, default 1.0, suffix " oct"
- INTEL_TONE_DARKENING: 0.0 to 2.0 octaves, default 0.75, suffix " oct"
- INTEL_WIDTH_REDUCTION: 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 35.0
- INTEL_ATTACK_SOFTEN_INCREASE: 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 45.0

Bloom:
- INTEL_BLOOM_RISE: 20.0 to 1500.0 ms, default 220.0, skewForCentre around 300.0, suffix " ms"
- INTEL_BLOOM_HOLD: 0.0 to 2000.0 ms, default 350.0, suffix " ms"
- INTEL_BLOOM_RELEASE: 50.0 to 3000.0 ms, default 800.0, skewForCentre around 700.0, suffix " ms"
- INTEL_WET_LIFT: 0.0 to 12.0 dB, default 4.0, suffix " dB"
- INTEL_TAIL_EXPANSION: 0.0 to 2.0 octaves, default 0.75, suffix " oct"
- INTEL_TONE_OPENING: 0.0 to 1.0 octaves, default 0.35, suffix " oct"
- INTEL_WIDTH_EXPANSION: 0.0 to 100.0 %, default 30.0
- INTEL_DIFFUSION_INCREASE: 0.0 to 30.0 %, default 12.0

Shared:
- INTEL_TRANSIENT_CROSSOVER: 1000.0 to 6000.0 Hz, default 2500.0, skewForCentre around 2500.0, suffix " Hz"

That is 23 parameters added by this task. Every ID must come from a shredspace::paramids constant. CRITICAL: these are the adaptive engine's TUNING parameters only. The engine's runtime internal state — running means and deviations, FFT history, onset timestamps, current activity/density/sustain/phrase-gap values, telemetry, safety intervention state — must NEVER be added to APVTS. No third-party dependency. No artist or song names.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp defines shredspace::addIntelligenceParameters with a non-empty body adding exactly 23 parameters

g++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only -I JUCE/modules -I Source -DJUCE_GLOBAL_MODULE_SETTINGS_INCLUDED=1 -DJUCE_MODULE_AVAILABLE_juce_audio_processors=1 -DJUCE_STANDALONE_APPLICATION=0 Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp passes with no errors
Every intelligence parameter uses a shredspace::paramids INTEL_ constant rather than a raw string literal ID
The INTEL ranges and defaults in Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp are exactly the values listed in this task description
No APVTS parameter is added for detector running means, deviations, FFT history, onset timestamps, runtime density/sustain/phrase-gap values, telemetry, or safety intervention state
The helpers written by tasks b.2 and b.3 are left unmodified
No file outside Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rewrite, reformat, or reorder the helpers written by tasks b.2 and b.3
add any adaptive-engine runtime state as an APVTS parameter

allowed: choose skew and step details within the stated ranges
group the three INTEL sections with comments inside one function
forbidden: change any stated range or default
implement adaptive detector logic in this file
